json.name: sample-clarity
json.description:
Sample Clarity checks that the speech is easy to follow.

You get a flag when the wording is confusing enough to interrupt the conversation.

json.name: sample-noise
json.description:
Sample Noise checks that the recording is free of **hum** and *crackle*.

- Loose cables
- Gain set too high

json.name: sample_pacing
json.description: Sample Pacing checks that both speakers take turns naturally.
